A.objective: Determine which represented billed revenue is associated with counterparties whose active contracts contain acquisition-relevant conditions, and report each qualifying invoice with source-native identifiers and invoice attributes.

universe_scope.sources: authoritative files in this data room only
entities: counterparties named on invoices and contracts
exclusions: inferences drawn from outside the data room

required_output_shape.identifier_fidelity: report counterparty and contract identifiers as they appear in the sources

world_true: invoice_id, billed_name, amount, currency, period, and status as recorded in billing sources
contract_id and contractual clause text as recorded in contract sources
contract effective dates, expiration, and stated term mechanics
counterparty names as stated on invoices and in contract parties clauses
purpose_analytical: whether a contract is active for this purpose (an expired statement of work is not active)
whether a contractual term is acquisition-relevant for this purpose
whether a billed name can be associated with a contract counterparty for this purpose

epistemic_requirements: Do not treat missing identity as a negative contractual finding.
If a billed name and a contract counterparty cannot be confidently associated, record association as unresolved rather than omitting the invoice or asserting the join.
Only emit association asserted when the invoice-to-contract counterparty link is confidently supported.
Ground asserted associations and unresolved gaps with evidence traceable to authoritative sources.

allowed_unresolved_states.meaning: invoice is represented billed revenue that may relate to acquisition-relevant active contract exposure, but the billed-name to contract-counterparty link cannot be confidently established

completeness_expectations.row_inclusion_policy: include each invoice that qualifies under purpose-specific active-contract and acquisition-relevant-clause criteria
must_report: contract_id when association is asserted or the unresolved case still has a candidate contract context
completeness_expectations.must_not_suppress: qualifying invoices solely because identity linkage is uncertain; use unresolved instead

acquisition_relevant_conditions: require consent or notice on a change of control
permit termination upon a change of control
require consent or notice before assignment, including assignment restricted except to affiliates or assignment prohibited to a competitor
purpose_specific_policies.active_contract_threshold: a contract counts as active for this purpose unless it is an expired statement of work; expired SoW is explicitly not active

association_dispositions.asserted: confident invoice billed_name to contract counterparty association
association_dispositions.unresolved: cannot confidently associate billed name with contract counterparty

B.objective: Identify represented customer and commercial identities across CRM, billing, the company registry, and contracts; for each commercially relevant name or record, report whether it is confidently the same legal counterparty as other records or whether identification remains unresolved.

universe_scope.sources: authoritative files in this data room only
entities: commercially relevant names and records spanning CRM accounts, invoice billed names, registry rows, and contract parties
exclusions: global merges based only on visual or fuzzy name similarity

required_output_shape.ordering: sort links by left ascending, then right ascending

world_true: CRM account identifiers and account names as recorded
invoice billed names as recorded in billing sources
registry company numbers and registered legal names as recorded
contract filenames and counterparty names as recorded in contract sources
purpose_analytical: whether two records refer to the same legal counterparty for diligence reconciliation
whether two records are confidently distinct legal entities
whether identity between records remains unresolved

epistemic_requirements: Do not globally merge records merely because two names look similar.
Exact legal-form variants of the same registered name may be treated as mechanical same-entity judgments.
Distinct registry entities with similar trade names are not automatically the same party.
Missing a positive same-entity judgment is not a negative judgment.
Ground SAME_ENTITY and DISTINCT judgments with evidence; unresolved must be explicit where confidence is insufficient.

allowed_unresolved_states.meaning: insufficient evidence to assert SAME_ENTITY or DISTINCT between the linked records

completeness_expectations.link_coverage: include every link required to connect a CRM account, its billed name, the contract governing that relationship, and any registry row that is a candidate legal entity for that relationship
completeness_expectations.pair_orientation: emit directed left/right pairs per schema; completeness is over the required reconciliation graph, not all possible cross-product pairs

purpose_specific_policies.merge_policy: no global merge on similarity alone
purpose_specific_policies.mechanical_same_entity: exact legal-form variants of the same registered name may be reconciled mechanically
purpose_specific_policies.distinct_by_default_for_similar_trade_na: distinct registry entities with similar trade names are not automatically the same party

epistemic_dispositions.DISTINCT: confidently not the same legal counterparty

C.objective: Compute a commercial dependency view identifying counterparties that are commercially dependent under purpose-specific current-relationship and obligation criteria.

universe_scope.sources: authoritative files in this data room only
universe_scope.identifier_dependency: use the same identifier forms as purpose B for counterparties
exclusions: dependencies inferred when required identity joins are unresolved

ordering.obligation_kinds: sorted list within each dependency row

world_true: invoice open/closed or equivalent status as recorded
contract term, renewal, exclusivity, and notice provisions as recorded in contract text
contract effective and expiration dates as recorded
counterparty identifiers and contract identifiers as compiled from sources
purpose_analytical: whether a commercial relationship is current for dependency analysis
whether a contract is active for dependency analysis
whether recorded obligations qualify as exclusivity, auto_renewal, or rolling_term for this purpose
whether a counterparty is commercially dependent under the conjunction of current-relationship and obligation policies

epistemic_requirements: If identity needed to join invoice and contract is unresolved, report the dependency as unresolved rather than as false.
Do not assert dependent status without both required policy conditions being confidently satisfied.
Ground dependent findings in current relationship evidence and qualifying obligation clauses traceable to sources.

allowed_unresolved_states.meaning: dependency cannot be confidently assessed, including when invoice-to-contract or counterparty identity joins required for the analysis remain unresolved

completeness_expectations.row_inclusion_policy: report each contract-centric dependency row that is either confidently dependent or must be left unresolved under epistemic rules
must_report_when_dependent: open_invoice_ids supporting current relationship when applicable
obligation_kinds drawn from the allowed vocabulary
completeness_expectations.must_not_assert_false_negative: unresolved identity or join uncertainty must not be rendered as non-dependency

purpose_specific_policies.commercial_dependency_definition: a counterparty is commercially dependent when both policy conditions hold
purpose_specific_policies.current_relationship_condition: there is a current commercial relationship evidenced by an open invoice, or an active contract that auto-renews or continues on a rolling term
purpose_specific_policies.obligation_condition: the active contract contains an exclusivity commitment, or a term auto-renewal, or a rolling term that continues unless notice is given
purpose_specific_policies.active_contract_for_dependency: expired contracts do not create current dependency
purpose_specific_policies.historical_invoice_exclusion: a one-off paid historical invoice without an active contract does not establish current dependency

status_dispositions.dependent: both current-relationship and obligation policies are confidently satisfied for the counterparty-contract pair
status_dispositions.unresolved: dependency cannot be confidently determined, including unresolved identity needed for joins
